values.note: Standard campsite $28; Interagency Senior/Access cardholders $14 (single standard site only).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233954/rates (2026 season Apr 4-Oct 31 and 2027: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 28), read 2026-10-22 + https://gofindoutdoors.org/carolina-hemlocks/ (Fees: 'Standard Campsite $28', Interagency & Senior $14), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233954 ('Carolina Hemlocks Recreation Area offers 35 primitive campsites') + RIDB catalog for 233954 (every campsite typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: recreation.gov's catalog: 35 standard sites (20 reservable, 15 first-come); RV lengths mostly 30 ft, three at 35 ft; 10 pull-throughs. The operator's page says 31 campsites, some with river access.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233954 ('35 primitive campsites') + RIDB catalog for 233954 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry, reservable flag), read 2026-10-22 + https://gofindoutdoors.org/carolina-hemlocks/ ('31 Campsites', 'Sites with River Access')

values.note: Firewood and ice sold. Generators up to four hours a day, 8 a.m.-8 p.m. Limited cell service. (The Forest Service page's amenity block says no restrooms or potable water, apparently describing the day-use area.)

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233954 ('The facility provides hot showers and restrooms with flush toilets. Campers can purchase firewood, ice', 'Generators may be used up to four hours per day between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m.'), read 2026-10-22 + https://gofindoutdoors.org/carolina-hemlocks/ ('Modern Bath Houses with Hot Showers')

values.note: The 2026 recreation.gov rate season ran Apr 4-Oct 31.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/carolina-hemlocks-recreation-area ('Seasons of Use: April 15th - October 31st'), read 2026-10-22 + https://gofindoutdoors.org/carolina-hemlocks/ ('Open April-October')

values.note: Run for the Forest Service by FIND Outdoors (formerly the Cradle of Forestry In America Interpretive Association), (828) 675-5509; 15 of the 35 sites are first-come. Gate hours 7 a.m.-10 p.m.; call ahead for a late arrival.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233954 ('First-come, first-served campsites are available', 'This campground is managed by the Cradle of Forestry In America Interpretive Association', 'Campground open from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.; notify campground of late arrivals by calling (828) 675-5509') + the Forest Service page ('The site is operated by FIND Outdoors', 'For Reservations call: 877-444-6777 or go to www.recreation.gov') + RIDB catalog (15 sites non-reservable), read 2026-10-22 + https://gofindoutdoors.org/carolina-hemlocks/ ('operated by FIND Outdoors in partnership with the U.S. Forest Service', 'Reservations CANNOT be made by calling the office ... call the reservation line 877.444.6777, use the reserve link')

values.note: Senior/Access discount applies only to the single standard site rate ($14); cardholder must be present.

discounts.source: https://gofindoutdoors.org/carolina-hemlocks/ ('Federal Interagency Senior/Access discounts only apply to the single standard site rate. Does not apply to any other items or services. Cardholder must be present on site to use discount.'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Open in 2026 (FS: campground open, fishing pier day-use area still closed from storm damage; October 2026 nights booked). Confirmed $28 and no electric; added 35 sites to 35 ft with 10 pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets, season Apr 15-Oct 31, recreation.gov with 15 first-come sites, operator FIND Outdoors (own page gofindoutdoors.org says 31 sites), Senior/Access half-price on standard sites. AWH note kept. Not stated: water/sewer at site, dump station, booking window (inherited).
